method: Follow-up single-reviewer visual audit of every emitted detection in its corresponding raw frame. This complements the independently pre-recorded uniform spot checks; it is not a coach-labelled validation dataset. Correct means the predicted centre lies on or very close to the active ball. No model output was used to define an athlete score.

clips.note: All detections are in the upper scene/background, while the active ball remains near the bottom or beyond the side edge. No airborne juggling occurs in the excerpt.
Most centres fall on the jersey/torso. At 0.7 s the centre is on the active ball near the feet.
At 0.2 s a detected patch is on the active ball. Other clearly lit detections select body/clothing. The 0.8 s frame is too dark to classify confidently and is excluded from precision.
